texts.name: Faiz
texts.biography: Faiz is notorious in the Silver Cities for his gruesome countenance, which he usually covers with a scarf. His scars are the result of an encounter with Desert Orcs, and from that day the once light-hearted Mage turned himself to thoughts of devastation and ruin. Mastering these arts, Faiz has gained the ability to inflict intensive arcane destruction upon his enemies.

specialty.name: Disrupting Ray
specialty.description: Casts Disrupting Ray with effect increased by 10.
